c: Ars Gouda is a relic located in
. Once collected, it permanently unlocks the Bestiary, which is accessed from the Main Menu.

In the Bestiary, the player can view statistics for all the enemies they have killed on their save file. Some entries are colored yellow, which denotes a character unlock being tied to killing a certain number of that enemy.

The Ars Gouda is located to the far south of the starting area in Dairy Plant. Its location is tracked by a green arrow on the player's screen. Once Ars Gouda has been collected, it will no longer appear on the map.
Alternatively, the Ars Gouda can be unlocked in the
by casting the spell "thistooshouldhavebeenunlockedbydefault".
The Ars Gouda/Bestiary in use, particularly opened on the entry of the Pipeestrello.
The Bestiary is divided into three parts: the header, the left panel (which is a list of enemies to the left), and the right panel, which provides more information on a specific enemy.
The header of the Bestiary window indicates two numbers:
The number of unique enemies ever defeated;
The maximum number of unique enemies the player can encounter. It can be differentiated from the DLCs the player owns.

The left panel of the Bestiary is a scrollable list of enemies with their bestiary number indicated. If their name is indicated in yellow, this means that they are associated with an unlock (e.g. to unlock

, a total of 3,000 Skeletons must be defeated), otherwise, the enemies are indicated with white-colored names in the list. The currently selected enemy in the Bestiary would have their name highlighted with a yellowish tint and an arrow indicated to the left. An enemy that isn't encountered yet will have their number listed, but their name listed as ---------------.
The right panel of the Bestiary provides information on a selected enemy. From top to bottom, the following information is provided:
The number of times this enemy has been defeated by the player;
The looks of the enemy and its variants, shown on the background of a stage that they are from[1] (if they appear in multiple stages, the background will be chosen randomly);
An entry that describes the enemy;

The enemy's resistances;
The enemy's skills;
The stages that the enemy appears in;
Clicking on the entry of an enemy that isn't encountered yet will indicate 0 defeated enemies, the image showcasing a question mark on a
background, the textual entry being marked as "???", and the values for each stat being marked as "?".
Since the Bestiary is accessed from the Main Menu, there is a red "BACK" button indicated at the top, next to the counter of
Gold Coins. Pressing it will lead back to the Main Menu.
